name: Starter
author: juwri
description: Minimal working OS 2.0 theme — the documented package skeleton. Vertical-aware: every noun runs through the {{ vocab }} global, so the same package reads "Menu/Dish" for a restaurant and "Catalog/Product" for a goods or services store. RTL-ready (logical CSS + {{ localization.direction }}) with a bundled Arabic locale. Copy it, rename the slug, and build.
